ui.schedules.monitors.blind_health.role: Health tail of a Schedules page monitor row whose watch is blind and the backend sent no health sentence
ui.schedules.monitors.blind_health.tone: Factual, lowercase start, no terminal period
ui.schedules.monitors.blind_health.length: One short clause; it shares a line with the cadence and last-check clauses
ui.schedules.monitors.blind_health.note: A blind monitor still runs its check but cannot compare one result with the last, so it silently reports nothing. Rendered in warning ink after a middle dot. Normally the backend's own English health sentence fills this slot; this is the fallback.

ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_load_mon.role: Failure strip under the Schedules page Monitors heading when the monitor listing request failed
ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_load_mon.tone: Plain statement of what failed, full sentence with period
ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_load_mon.note: Monitor twin of ui.schedules.schedules_page.could_not_load_scheduled_tasks; it must name monitors because the wakes above it may have loaded fine.

ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_read_mon.role: Warning under the Schedules page Monitors heading when the machine's monitor index could not be read
ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_read_mon.tone: Plain, cautionary, full sentence with period
ui.schedules.monitors.could_not_read_mon.note: Monitor twin of ui.schedules.schedules_page.could_not_read_this_machine_s_scheduled_tasks_so_the_list_below_m. Says this list (the monitors shown under the warning), not the list below, may be incomplete.

ui.schedules.monitors.count_needs_attent.role: Trailing clause on a conversation row in the Schedules page Monitors section when some of its monitors are disabled, blind or expired
ui.schedules.monitors.count_needs_attent.tone: Factual tally, sentence fragment, no terminal period
ui.schedules.monitors.count_needs_attent.length: Short; English example is 2 monitors · 1 needs attention
ui.schedules.monitors.count_needs_attent.note: Replaces ui.chat.run_details.monitor.armed_count when not every monitor is working, so the row never calls a disabled monitor armed. Keep the middle dot separator. Two independent counts, each with its own plural. Plural: Each count needs its own locale plural arms (ru: one/few/many/other; es/fr: one/many/other).

placeholders.total: Number of monitors on the conversation, selects the first plural.
placeholders.attention: Number of those monitors that are disabled, blind or expired, selects the second plural.

ui.schedules.monitors.expired_state.role: when-label of a monitor row whose until time has passed
ui.schedules.monitors.expired_state.note: Sits in the same slot and register as ui.schedules.monitors.parked_state and ui.chat.run_details.monitor.disabled; agree with the noun monitor in this locale. Replaces the next-check time, because an expired monitor will not check again.

ui.schedules.monitors.list_truncated.role: Schedules page Monitors section truncated-list footnote: visible versus total monitor-carrying conversations
ui.schedules.monitors.list_truncated.tone: Factual count, not a complete-list claim.
ui.schedules.monitors.list_truncated.length: One brief footnote sentence; English example is Showing 1 of 2 conversations with monitors.
ui.schedules.monitors.list_truncated.note: Twin of ui.schedules.count.list_truncated for the Monitors section; keep the two parallel in each locale, with the counted noun naming conversations that have monitors. A monitor is a read-only watch an agent re-runs on an interval. Real ICU one/other arms select the counted noun. Russian translators need few/many arms; Arabic translators need zero/two and locale-appropriate few/many. English 0/1/2 selects other/one/other. Plural: ru: add few/many; ar: add zero/two; preserve the count parameter and its existing ICU numeric style.

placeholders.shown: monitorsListing.data.entries.length, raw visible count, ICU number ::group-off.
placeholders.total: monitorsListing.data.total, raw backend count selecting ICU plural.

ui.schedules.monitors.parked_clause.role: Trailing clause on a conversation row in the Schedules page Monitors section when the conversation is stopped or gone
ui.schedules.monitors.parked_clause.tone: Factual state, sentence case, no terminal period
ui.schedules.monitors.parked_clause.note: Replaces the monitor count on a parked conversation. Its monitors stay armed but do not check while it is parked; do not promise when they resume. Keep the same leading parked word the wake clause uses in this locale.

ui.schedules.monitors.parked_state.role: when-label of a monitor row whose conversation is parked
ui.schedules.monitors.parked_state.note: Sits in the same slot and register as ui.chat.run_details.monitor.disabled and ui.chat.run_details.monitor.waiting; agree with the noun monitor in this locale.
